text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Doxepin is routinely administered for indications other than insomnia at doses 10- to 50-fold higher than the highest recommended dose of doxepin. The signs and symptoms associated with doxepin use at doses several-fold higher than the maximum recommended dose (Excessive dose) of doxepin for the treatment of insomnia are described [ see Overdosage (10.1) ], as are signs and symptoms associated with higher multiples of the maximum recommended dose (Critical overdose) [ see Overdosage (10.2) ].
